title: 卡莲 · 晨间餐桌的毒舌与暖汤
description: 【卡莲 · 晨间餐桌的毒舌与暖汤】阳光洒在教会餐厅质朴的木餐桌上。卡莲身着宽大的冬日红色牛角扣大衣，双手端着一碗冒着热气的浓汤递到你面前。她推了推头顶可爱的毛线帽，微微昂起精致小巧的下巴，用平淡无波却字字见血的毒舌调侃你，嘴角却有一丝温柔笑意——「听说无能的懒汉通常会睡到日上三竿呢。不过看在你还活着的份上，这碗汤就大发慈悲赏给你了。」
location: 质朴明亮的教会餐厅长木餐桌前
action: 双手将热汤碗递到桌前，帽子保持原位，微微昂起下巴
lighting: 晨光穿透高耸拱形窗洒在木质桌面上
camera: cowboy shot, eye level, domestic tsundere view
promptProse: At the church dining table, Caren offers a steaming bowl of vegetable soup with both hands held steadily beneath it. Her white knitted beanie stays in place above short layered silver hair, leaving the gesture free of a simultaneous hat adjustment. The red duffle coat is closed over her ordinary winter clothes. She lifts her chin with a dry, teasing expression while her amber-yellow eyes show a little concern for the recipient. Morning light reaches the bowl and wooden tabletop through the high window. One fully clothed figure, no lettering.

title: 卡莲 · 冬日雪街的热可可小憩
description: 【卡莲 · 冬日雪街的热可可小憩】白雪覆盖的商店街长椅旁，卡莲双手捧着热可可纸杯，在啜饮后停下脚步回头。短短的银白发梢露在毛线帽边，红色大衣挡住寒风；她的琥珀色眼眸在路灯下泛起一丝安宁的笑意。
location: 银装素裹、华灯初上的冬日商店街街角长椅
action: 啜饮后双手稳住纸杯，停在长椅旁回头微笑
lighting: 街边暖黄路灯与初雪反光的清冽微芒
camera: cowboy shot, eye level, peaceful winter street view
promptProse: Beside a snowy shopping-street bench, Caren pauses after a small sip of hot chocolate and turns toward the viewer. Both hands remain wrapped around the paper cup beneath her chin. Short silver strands show at the edge of the white beanie rather than falling down the back of her closed red coat. Her amber-yellow eyes soften slightly in the streetlamp glow, with a small breath cloud visible in the cold air. The evening view includes the bench, cup and warmly clothed figure, without readable labels or lettering.

title: 卡莲 · 破晓圣坛的圣骸之誓
description: 【卡莲 · 破晓圣坛的圣骸之誓】破晓时分的宏伟大教堂圣坛前，第一束金色晨曦穿透破损的穹顶照亮整个圣域。卡莲身着纯白圣洁的露肩婚纱，金色的抹大拉圣骸布化作头纱与后摆在朝阳中散发着神圣光辉。她双手捧着一束白百合花走向你，眼眶湿润泛着晶莹的泪珠，清冷的声线带着无尽的释怀与爱意——「承载了世间所有恶意的我……终于在你的怀里，找到了唯一的救赎与归宿。」
location: 金色晨曦破晓照耀的大教堂宏伟圣坛前
action: 双手捧白百合缓步走向圣坛前方，抬眼微笑，保持双手托花
lighting: 穿透破晓云层与大理石穹顶的万丈神圣天光
camera: full-body frontal shot, slow step, complete gown and bouquet visible
promptProse: Caren takes a slow step forward before the dawn-lit altar, holding a bouquet of white lilies securely in both hands. Her opaque white formal bridal gown falls to the floor, with the golden shroud arranged as a veil and trailing cloth rather than exposing the body. Short silver hair frames her amber-yellow eyes as she offers a small, relieved smile. Warm light from the dome reveals the lilies, fabric folds and careful step. Show the complete ceremonial outfit and two hands supporting the flowers within the vertical frame. No lettering.
